Custom identifiers with $prop and $isid, $result, local variables, and math assignment.
-- origin --
spec
-- script.mrc --
alias add {
  %x = $1 + $2
  if ($prop == negative) return $calc(-1 * %x)
  return %x
}
alias who { return $iif($isid,identifier,command) }
alias scope {
  var %local = inner
  echo -s %local
}
alias test {
  echo -s Total is: $add(1,2)
  echo -s Total is: $add(1,2).negative
  echo -s $who
  who
  echo -s $result
  var %local = outer
  scope
  echo -s %local
  set %y 1 + 2
  echo -s y: %y
  set -n %z 1 + 2
  echo -s z: %z
}
-- output --
Total is: 3
Total is: -3
identifier
command
inner
outer
y: 3
z: 1 + 2
